title: Research and study
description: A folder per topic with sources (PDFs, links, notes); summaries, quotes, a summary table, gaps, a plan; Claude may search the web.
folderHint: A folder where every subfolder is a topic

commands.title: Source summary
commands.task: Summarise the chosen source: what it is about in 2–3 sentences; the main points as a list; key numbers and definitions; what in it is disputable or unproven; how it relates to the project's topic. Only what is in the source — no additions from general knowledge (mark any context you add as «outside the source»).

commands.title: Quotes with references
commands.task: Pick from the project's sources the quotes most useful for the topic — verbatim, with the file and page/section if available. Group them by subtopic. Do not paraphrase anything in this file.

commands.title: Summary table
commands.task: Put the project's sources into a table: source, year/author (if known), main point, methods or data, why it is useful for the topic, limitations. Under the table — where the sources agree and where they contradict each other.

commands.title: Not yet covered
commands.task: From the project's materials, find the questions of the topic they do not cover or cover poorly. For each gap — why it matters and what source or data would close it. Do not invent specific sources — describe what to look for.

commands.title: Work plan
commands.task: Draft a plan of a text (article, talk, term paper) from the project's materials: sections, what goes into each, which sources to rely on, an approximate length. Mark where material is still missing.
